Name: Fire Ring
Text: Fire attacks apply BURNING status to target. BURNING enemies receive 10% DMG each turn.

Name: Frozen Ring
Text: Ice attacks apply CHILLED status to target. CHILLED enemies lose 1 attack each turn.

Name: Thunder Ring
Text: Lightning attacks apply SHOCKED status to target. SHOCKED enemies have 25% chance to miss.

Name: Earth Ring
Text: Earth attacks apply WEIGHTED status to target. WEIGHTED enemies deal 25% less DMG.
